Bill.BriefDescription: Providing sales and use tax exemptions for solar hot water components.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing tax exemptions for solar hot watercomponents; adding a new section to chapter 82.08 RCW; adding a newsection to chapter 82.12 RCW; and providing an expiration date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The tax levied by RCW 82.08.020 does not apply to sales ofsolar water heating components, including repair and replacement partsfor such components, or to sales of or charges made for labor andservices rendered in respect to installing, repairing, cleaning,altering, or improving such components. (2) A person taking the exemption under this section must keeprecords necessary for the department to verify eligibility under thissection. This exemption is available only when the buyer provides theseller with an exemption certificate in a form and manner prescribed bythe department. The seller shall retain a copy of the certificate forthe seller's files.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The provisions of this chapter do not apply in respect to the useof solar water heating components; repair and replacement parts forsuch components; or to sales of or charges made for labor and servicesrendered in respect to installing, repairing, cleaning, altering, orimproving such components.
